756inline Argument_editor::Argument_editor(
757 ITransaction* transaction, const char* name, IMdl_factory* mdl_factory, bool intent_to_edit)
758{
759 mi_neuray_assert( transaction);
760 mi_neuray_assert( name);
761
762 m_transaction = make_handle_dup( transaction);
763 m_name = name;
764 m_mdl_factory = make_handle_dup( mdl_factory);
765 m_value_factory
766 = m_mdl_factory ? m_mdl_factory->create_value_factory( m_transaction.get()) : 0;
767 m_expression_factory
768 = m_mdl_factory ? m_mdl_factory->create_expression_factory( m_transaction.get()) : 0;
769
770 if( intent_to_edit) {
771 m_edit = transaction->edit<IFunction_call>( name);
772 m_access = m_edit;
773 m_old_access = m_edit;
774 m_type = m_access ? m_access->get_element_type() : static_cast<Element_type>( 0);
775 } else {
776 m_access = transaction->access<IFunction_call>( name);
777 m_type = m_access ? m_access->get_element_type() : static_cast<Element_type>( 0);
778 }
779}

890 m_transaction.get(), m_value_factory.get(), m_access.get(), index, /*error*/ 0));

892 return true;
893 return b->get_value();
894}

945template <class T>
946Sint32 Argument_editor::get_value( Size parameter_index, T& value) const
947{
948 if( !is_valid())
949 return -1;
950
951 base::Handle<const IExpression_list> arguments( m_access->get_arguments());
952 base::Handle<const IExpression> argument( arguments->get_expression( parameter_index));
953 if( !argument)
954 return -2;
955 base::Handle<const IExpression_constant> argument_constant(
956 argument->get_interface<IExpression_constant>());
957 if( !argument_constant)
958 return -4;
959 base::Handle<const IValue> argument_value( argument_constant->get_value());
960 Sint32 result = neuraylib::get_value( argument_value.get(), value);
961 return result == 0 ? 0 : -5;
962}

1099template <class T>
1100Sint32 Argument_editor::set_value( Size parameter_index, const T& value)
1101{
1102 if( !is_valid())
1103 return -1;
1104
1105 promote_to_edit_if_needed();
1106
1107 if( m_edit->is_default())
1108 return -4;
1109 base::Handle<const IExpression_list> arguments( m_edit->get_arguments());
1110 base::Handle<const IExpression> argument( arguments->get_expression( parameter_index));
1111 if( !argument)
1112 return -2;
1113 base::Handle<const IType> type( argument->get_type());
1114 base::Handle<IValue> new_value( m_value_factory->create( type.get()));
1115 Sint32 result = neuraylib::set_value( new_value.get(), value);
1116 if( result != 0)
1117 return -5;
1118 base::Handle<IExpression> new_expression(
1119 m_expression_factory->create_constant( new_value.get()));
1120 result = m_edit->set_argument( parameter_index, new_expression.get());
1121 mi_neuray_assert( result == 0);
1122 return result;
1123}
1124

1211template <class T>
1212Sint32 Argument_editor::set_value( Size parameter_index, Size component_index, const T& value)
1213{
1214 if( !is_valid())
1215 return -1;
1216
1217 promote_to_edit_if_needed();
1218
1219 if( m_edit->is_default())
1220 return -4;
1221 base::Handle<const IExpression_list> arguments( m_edit->get_arguments());
1222 base::Handle<const IExpression> argument( arguments->get_expression( parameter_index));
1223 if( !argument)
1224 return -2;
1225 if( argument->get_kind() == IExpression::EK_CONSTANT) {
1226 // reuse existing constant expression
1227 base::Handle<IExpression> new_argument( m_expression_factory->clone( argument.get()));
1228 base::Handle<IExpression_constant> new_argument_constant(
1229 new_argument->get_interface<IExpression_constant>());
1230 base::Handle<IValue> new_value( new_argument_constant->get_value());
1231 Sint32 result = neuraylib::set_value( new_value.get(), component_index, value);
1232 if( result != 0)
1233 return result == -3 ? -3 : -5;
1234 result = m_edit->set_argument( parameter_index, new_argument.get());
1235 mi_neuray_assert( result == 0);
1236 return result;
1237 } else {
1238 // create new constant expression
1239 base::Handle<const IType> type( argument->get_type());
1240 base::Handle<IValue> new_value( m_value_factory->create( type.get()));
1241 Sint32 result = neuraylib::set_value( new_value.get(), component_index, value);
1242 if( result != 0)
1243 return result == -3 ? -3 : -5;
1244 base::Handle<IExpression> new_expression(
1245 m_expression_factory->create_constant( new_value.get()));
1246 result = m_edit->set_argument( parameter_index, new_expression.get());
1247 mi_neuray_assert( result == 0);
1248 return result;
1249 }
1250}
